local_attempt.note: The same one-line computation (delta_full = fullAfter - fullBefore) failed with a Python syntax error (mismatched parentheses) THREE separate times across three retried steps (3, 7, 10) — the identical bug recurring rather than being corrected by retries, similar to the sanitizer-repairable stray-indent pattern documented elsewhere in this codebase's error ledger. Never reached causal estimation. See notes.md.

estimate.note: GADS canonical from cloud reference run (drafted lane, OLS DiD, without chain fixed effects): +2.93 full-time EMPLOYEES (with chain FE: +2.82), 95% CI roughly ±3.4 so not statistically distinguishable from zero. NOT directly comparable to the QRData gold: the run modeled the outcome as an FTE employment LEVEL/count, while QRData's gold (-0.062) is defined on the PROPORTION of full-time employees. Different outcome scale, not just a sign disagreement — see notes.md. Do not treat this as a validated match or a contradiction of the external gold; it is a genuine framing divergence worth investigating, not yet reconciled.
